principles: One brand orange carries all emphasis (brand mark, key numbers, active state, status dots)
Radius ladder: cards 20–28px, tiles 12–14px, controls circular/pill
All surfaces use a 2px peach outline (light tint of brand), never grey/black
Two-family system: rounded display family for headings/numbers (bold), neutral sans for body
Filled rounded glyphs, single colour, same optical size across the app bar, tiles and nav
palette_strategy: One brand orange carries all emphasis (brand mark, key numbers, active state, status dots); secondary tints are reserved for category tiles only.

components.radius: Radius ladder: cards 20–28px, tiles 12–14px, controls circular/pill; nothing below 12px except text.
components.button.icon: Circular 44px white button with 2px peach outline and orange glyph.
components.nav: Bottom nav active state = peach pill + orange icon/label; max 4–5 items.

anti_patterns: Mixing rules from two references that conflict without a resolved entry in conflicts
Copying a reference pixel-for-pixel instead of extracting rules
Dropping the closest catalog style as fallback for gaps
Treating a single screenshot as proof of motion or typography
qa_criteria: palette: One brand orange carries all emphasis (brand mark, key numbers, active state, status dots); secondary tints are reserved for category tiles only.
radius: Radius ladder: cards 20–28px, tiles 12–14px, controls circular/pill; nothing below 12px except text.
outline: All surfaces use a 2px peach outline (light tint of brand), never grey/black; outline is the primary separation device, shadow is secondary.
typography: Two-family system: rounded display family for headings/numbers (bold), neutral sans for body; captions one step smaller and muted.
icon: Filled rounded glyphs, single colour, same optical size across the app bar, tiles and nav.
button.icon: Circular 44px white button with 2px peach outline and orange glyph.
nav: Bottom nav active state = peach pill + orange icon/label; max 4–5 items.
Every rule in style-profile.json cites an observation id
Fields with no observation are marked not-derivable or inherited from a named catalog style
Text contrast at least 4.5:1 after extraction (adjust text, not background)
Enum fields hold valid catalog values, never free text

intentional_exceptions.rule: Category tiles may use the secondary tints (blue/mint) — an intentional context exception to rule-1.

catalog_rules.shape_language: derived from reference-analysis.json (observations with category shape)
catalog_rules.outline_rule: derived from reference-analysis.json (rules targeting button.primary and icon; width in px and colour rule required)
catalog_rules.highlight_rule: derived from reference-analysis.json (observations with category shading)
catalog_rules.shadow_rule: derived from reference-analysis.json (observations with category shading; default to none when not-derivable)
catalog_rules.typography_direction: derived from reference-analysis.json (observations with category typography; font family is usually not-derivable from screenshots, record the classification instead)
catalog_rules.icon_style: derived from reference-analysis.json (observations with category iconography)
catalog_rules.illustration_style: derived from reference-analysis.json (observations with category character)
catalog_rules.button_rule: derived from reference-analysis.json (rules targeting button.primary; context:popup overrides win over global)
catalog_rules.hud_rule: derived from reference-analysis.json (rules targeting hud; if no gameplay reference exists, inherit from the genre profile)
catalog_rules.reward_rule: derived from reference-analysis.json (reference with screen_type reward if present; otherwise inherit from the closest catalog style)
catalog_rules.best_for: derived from reference-analysis.json (use product.kind and genre from the profile; this row is a template, not a catalog style)
catalog_rules.avoid_for: derived from reference-analysis.json (anything the references do not show; mark as not-derivable instead of guessing)
catalog_rules.reference_notes: Template row: enum fields (Family, Radius Class, Shading, Motion Class) hold neutral fallbacks that vd.py profile --reference must overwrite from reference-analysis.json; Seed Colors are a neutral grey fallback for the same reason
